reason: sivtr primarily provides searchable memory and context for agents and humans by capturing terminal and agent-session records, exposing them through CLI and MCP tools, and supporting optional workspace sharing.

summaries.zh: sivtr 将终端输出和智能体会话整理为可搜索的本地记忆，并通过 CLI 与 MCP 提供上下文检索和引用。
summaries.en: sivtr organizes terminal output and agent sessions into searchable workspace memory, with context retrieval and references available through its CLI and MCP tools.

capabilities: Captures shell commands and stdout/stderr through shell hooks or command execution
Indexes and searches local terminal history and supported AI-agent session data
Provides MCP tools for agents to search, inspect, filter, and contextualize stored records
Stores reusable named memory sets and references
Supports opt-in read-only remote workspace sharing and group synchronization
Installs or repairs hooks, MCP registrations, and optional skills through setup commands
